# scripts/Visual/ClothReset.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/ClothReset.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Restarts spring-bone cloth after pose jumps and keeps its floor beneath limp hips.
Runs inside the skeleton update after physics and immediately before Cloth; restart() also covers recovery.

Base: `SkeletonModifier3D`. Registered class: `none`.
